critical_issues.msg: After BrokenPipeError on proc.stdin.write (prompt not delivered), the code proceeds to drain stdout/stderr — the Claude process then hangs waiting for stdin while we wait for its output, creating a permanent deadlock
critical_issues.suggestion: On BrokenPipeError, call proc.terminate() or proc.kill() before returning an error rather than continuing to stream output

suggestions.msg: pip install stderr is silenced with 2>/dev/null, masking the actual error when all fallback commands fail
suggestions.suggestion: Remove 2>/dev/null so set -e propagates the real error message to the workflow log

suggestions.msg: Hardcoded pip install of test dependencies duplicates pyproject.toml, creating a maintenance hazard when versions drift
suggestions.suggestion: Use a constraints file or rely solely on `pip install -e ".[dev]"` via pyproject.toml; remove explicit package list

suggestions.msg: docker health check uses a fixed retry count ({1..30}) rather than a time-based deadline, making it fragile under load or slow startup
suggestions.suggestion: Add a wall-clock deadline (e.g. --timeout 60s) or calculate remaining time against an absolute start timestamp so the wait is bounded by duration, not attempt count

suggestions.msg: -uall flag on git status can cause memory exhaustion in large repos; in a CI workflow with ephemeral runners and a freshly checked-out repo this is not needed
Comment says "origin/master may be missing" but the code does not guard this case — git log/diff exit gracefully with a message, so this is informational only
suggestions.suggestion: No action needed; informational note that the || echo guard on line 148 covers this adequately

suggestions.msg: proc.wait(timeout=max(1, timeout - elapsed)) — if elapsed > timeout this evaluates to max(1, negative), which is 1 second; however the process was already killed at line 106 so this wait call is for cleanup only — correct but subtle and fragile if the kill timing changes
suggestions.suggestion: Use max(0, timeout - elapsed) for clarity, or add a comment explaining that 1-second floor exists to avoid zero-length wait

suggestions.msg: Required env vars ISSUE_NUMBER and PLAN_PATH are read with .get() returning "" rather than validated with a clear fatal message before use
suggestions.suggestion: log() call at line 136 is already structured; this is informational noting that the missing-env log is adequate

suggestions.msg: CLAUDE_MODEL env var falls back to claude-sonnet-4-6 in code, but the workflow always passes --model explicitly (line 150); this default is dead code in the CI context
suggestions.suggestion: No action needed; the fallback is useful for local dev invocation of the script
